The only function that could potentially execute code during sourcing is `pkgver()`, but in this case, the function is defined and not called at the top level. `makepkg --printsrcinfo` does not invoke `pkgver()` — it only sources the file to extract metadata. Therefore, no commands inside `pkgver()` are executed. The rest of the functions (`build`, `package`) are irrelevant for this command and are not executed.

There is no command substitution, no network operations, and no suspicious code in the global scope. The file uses standard AUR packaging patterns consistent with a well-maintained -git package.
</details>
